run_lint_session: run pre-commit hooks on all files to lint the pybind11 codebase
run_tests_session: run cmake-based tests across multiple Python versions including pypy with catch and eigen
run_tests_packaging_session: run pytest on the extra_python_package directory to validate packaging
build_docs_session: build HTML or PDF documentation using sphinx and optionally serve locally
build_wheels_session: build SDists and wheels for both normal and PYBIND11_GLOBAL_SDIST variants
